method_note: These findings compare crawler outputs against direct official-site/LLM validation. Only NIT currently has a full LLM-native structured JSON draft; the other schools have official-site validation summaries.

schools.most_serious_issue: Graduate Studies Application was treated as a program, GRE/GATE was extracted from a negated sentence saying master applicants need not submit GRE or GATE, and several MSc pages were marked as PhD.
suggested_rules: Strengthen program-page classification so application-general pages do not become program records.
Add negation handling for GRE/GATE/GMAT phrases such as need not submit and not required.
Constrain degree extraction to title/key-facts areas instead of full-page navigation text.

schools.most_serious_issue: Multiple programs had false GRE extraction, and Master International Business missed English test scores such as TOEFL 85, IELTS 6.5, ELS 112, Duolingo 115, PTE 56, and Cambridge 173/Grade B.
suggested_rules: Require exact GRE token and admissions-test context.
Extract all language tests in the same bullet/list instead of stopping after the first test.
Support PTE and Cambridge score formats.

schools.most_serious_issue: Category and overview pages were treated as concrete programs; bachelor/master overview records were marked as MBA; German language scores were polluted by percentages, week counts, money amounts, and unrelated numbers.
suggested_rules: Exclude listing pages such as /bachelor-programs and /master-programs from program records.
Extract degree only from trusted title/key-facts regions.
Only accept German scores in CEFR/TestDaF/DSH/telc-like formats.

schools.most_serious_issue: MBA pages did not show GRE/GMAT, but crawler extracted GRE; crawler also missed central MBA requirements such as first academic degree, 180 ECTS, and at least one year of work experience.
suggested_rules: Add FAQ/admission accordion extraction for requirement sections.
Require exact GRE/GMAT token and evidence-window validation.
Mark language or test blanks as review when admissions requirement links exist.

schools.most_serious_issue: Bachelor pages were contaminated by MBA degree text, and a 120-minute online assessment was extracted as a German language score. Master in Finance does have real GMAT/GRE and language requirements.
suggested_rules: Reject duration values such as 120-minute from language scores.
Constrain language score extraction to explicit test/certificate proximity.
Avoid full-page fallback for degree extraction.

schools.most_serious_issue: Crawler extracted zero programs even though SRH has official bachelor/master/MBA programs and program-specific admission requirement pages.
suggested_rules: Treat fetched-seed-but-zero-program output as broken or needs human review.
Follow SRH admission detail URL patterns such as /en/bachelor/.../admission-requirements/.
Use program finder/listing pages for discovery rather than final program records.

schools.most_serious_issue: FAQ and tuition pages were treated as programs with names like Programs; GRE was falsely extracted even though official KLU FAQ pages do not show GRE; TOEFL component/code-like numbers were treated as minimum scores.
suggested_rules: Exclude FAQ, financing, tuition, and program-list pages from program records.
Scope FAQ sections before merging shared requirements into programs.
Separate TOEFL total score from component scores and institution/code-like numbers.

schools.most_serious_issue: Three real programs were found, but all had false GRE extraction; SAP Engineering also missed the official English B2 requirement.
suggested_rules: Add CEFR B2/C1 language requirement extraction.
Require evidence snippet to contain an independent GRE token.
Keep language requirements even when they are CEFR instead of IELTS/TOEFL scores.

schools.school: NIT Northern Institute of Technology Management
schools.most_serious_issue: Crawler still keeps Technology Management overview/single-degree pages as separate records and misses admissions-page TOEFL/IELTS/C1 thresholds. LLM-native reading groups NIT into Technology Management MBA/M.A. and Business Analytics & AI M.Sc.
suggested_rules: Group NIT Technology Management single/double degree modes under one program family.
Merge central admissions requirements back into program records.
Keep GRE/GMAT as not required or not stated rather than a requirement.

schools.most_serious_issue: Crawler extracted zero programs, but official HSB degree-programme pages exist and carry program-specific admission requirements.
suggested_rules: Improve HSB discovery using /en/study/degree-programme/{slug}/ pages.
Treat zero-program outputs with successful seed fetches as broken/review.
Use official program list/search pages only as discovery seeds.

schools.most_serious_issue: Three master programs were marked as MBA and kept admissions-page titles instead of clean program names; master admissions pages include TOEFL 100, IELTS 7.0, TOEIC 850 when required, but crawler language requirements were empty.
suggested_rules: Extract program name and degree from H1/key facts, not admissions page title.
Represent GMAT/GRE as conditional when official wording says depending on profile.
Support TOEIC, PTE, and conditional language/test requirements.

schools.most_serious_issue: Overview/category pages such as /mba-master.html and /mba.html were treated as programs; multiple GRE values were false positives from degree text; central requirements contain IELTS/TOEFL thresholds that crawler missed.
suggested_rules: Exclude overview/category pages from final program records.
Merge central requirements page back into individual IGC programs.
Use exact GRE/GMAT token and context checks.
